metadata.description: Comprehensive species data for D&D 5e character creation (2014 & 2024)

species.name: Human
species.description: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common races. Whatever drives them, humans are the innovators, the achievers, and the pioneers of the worlds.

variants.name: Standard Human
variants.description: The classic human from the Basic Rules - +1 to all ability scores for broad versatility.

variants.name: Variant Human
variants.description: The specialist human - +1 to two abilities, one skill proficiency, and one feat for focused power.

species.name: Human
species.description: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common races. In the 2024 rules, they are defined by their versatility and resilience.

species.name: Mountain Dwarf
species.description: Bold and hardy, dwarves are known as skilled warriors, miners, and workers of stone and metal. Mountain dwarves are strong and hardy inhabitants of the mountains.

species.name: Hill Dwarf
species.description: Bold and hardy, dwarves are known as skilled warriors, miners, and workers of stone and metal. Hill dwarves are wise and tough inhabitants of the hills.

species.name: Dwarf
species.description: Dwarves are solid and enduring like the mountains they love, weathering the passage of centuries with stoic endurance.

species.name: High Elf
species.description: Elves are a magical people of otherworldly grace, living in the world but not entirely part of it. High elves are the most common elves, known for their intelligence and magical affinity.

species.name: Wood Elf
species.description: Elves are a magical people of otherworldly grace, living in the world but not entirely part of it. Wood elves are reclusive and suspicious of non-elves.

species.name: Drow (Dark Elf)
species.description: Elves are a magical people of otherworldly grace, living in the world but not entirely part of it. Drow, or dark elves, have black skin that resembles polished obsidian and stark white or pale yellow hair.

species.name: Elf
species.description: Elves are a magical people of otherworldly grace, living in the world but not entirely part of it.

variants.name: Drow Lineage
variants.description: Descended from the Underdark.

variants.name: High Elf Lineage
variants.description: Descended from the Feywild courts.

variants.name: Wood Elf Lineage
variants.description: Descended from the primeval forests.

species.name: Lightfoot Halfling
species.description: Halflings are cheerful, brave, and lucky people who live in close-knit communities. Lightfoot halflings are stealthy and charismatic.

species.name: Stout Halfling
species.description: Halflings are an affable and cheerful people. They cherish the bonds of family and friendship as well as the comforts of hearth and home. Stout halflings are hardier than average and have some resistance to poison.

species.name: Halfling
species.description: The diminutive halflings survive in a world full of larger creatures by avoiding notice or, barring that, avoiding offense.

species.name: Forest Gnome
species.description: Gnomes are small folk full of quirky inventiveness. Forest gnomes have a natural knack for illusion and a way with animals.

species.name: Rock Gnome
species.description: Gnomes are small folk full of quirky inventiveness. Rock gnomes are natural inventors and tinkerers.

species.name: Gnome
species.description: A constant hum of busy activity pervades the warrens and neighborhoods where gnomes form their close-knit communities.

variants.name: Forest Gnome Lineage
variants.description: Natural illusionists.

variants.name: Rock Gnome Lineage
variants.description: Natural tinkerers.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.description: Dragonborn look very much like dragons standing erect in humanoid form, though they lack wings or a tail. Dragonborn are proud, honorable warriors.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.description: Born of dragons, as their name proclaims, the dragonborn walk proudly through a world that greets them with fearful incomprehension.

species.name: Orc
species.description: Orcs are brutish, green-skinned humanoids that dwell in tribal societies. They are fierce warriors who revel in battle.

species.name: Orc
species.description: Orcs are people of deep emotion and great passion, renowned for their unyielding endurance and determination.

species.name: Tiefling
species.description: Tieflings are derived from human bloodlines, and in the broadest possible sense, they still look human. However, their infernal heritage has left a clear imprint on their appearance.

variants.name: Asmodeus
variants.description: The bloodline of Asmodeus: the Player's Handbook tiefling, with the standard Infernal Legacy.

variants.name: Baalzebul
variants.description: Legacy of Maladomini: thaumaturgy, ray of sickness and crown of madness.

variants.name: Dispater
variants.description: Legacy of Dis: DEX +1 and thaumaturgy, disguise self and detect thoughts.

variants.name: Fierna
variants.description: Legacy of Phlegethos: WIS +1 and friends, charm person and suggestion.

variants.name: Glasya
variants.description: Legacy of Malbolge: DEX +1 and minor illusion, disguise self and invisibility.

variants.name: Levistus
variants.description: Legacy of Stygia: CON +1 and ray of frost, armor of Agathys and darkness.

variants.name: Mammon
variants.description: Legacy of Minauros: mage hand, Tenser's floating disk and arcane lock.

variants.name: Mephistopheles
variants.description: Legacy of Cania: mage hand, burning hands and flame blade.

variants.name: Zariel
variants.description: Legacy of Avernus: STR +1 and thaumaturgy, searing smite and branding smite.

variants.name: Devil's Tongue
variants.description: SCAG variant: INT +1, DEX or CHA +2, vicious mockery, charm person and enthrall.

variants.name: Hellfire
variants.description: SCAG variant: INT +1, DEX or CHA +2, thaumaturgy, burning hands and darkness.

variants.name: Infernal Legacy (variant)
variants.description: SCAG variant: INT +1, DEX or CHA +2 and the standard Infernal Legacy, with an appearance that is more human than fiendish.

variants.name: Winged
variants.description: SCAG variant: INT +1, DEX or CHA +2, and bat-like wings that give a flying speed of 30 feet.

species.name: Tiefling
species.description: To be greeted with stares and whispers, to suffer violence and insult on the street, to see mistrust and fear in every eye: this is the lot of the tiefling.

variants.name: Abyssal Tiefling
variants.description: Descended from demons of the Abyss.

variants.name: Chthonic Tiefling
variants.description: Descended from fiends of the neutral lower planes.

variants.name: Infernal Tiefling
variants.description: Descended from devils of the Nine Hells.

species.name: Aasimar
species.description: Aasimars are mortals who carry a spark of the Upper Planes within their souls. They are humanoids with a touch of the celestial in their appearance.

variants.name: Necrotic Shroud
variants.description: Your Celestial Revelation unleashes a shroud of necrotic energy that frightens nearby foes.

variants.name: Radiant Consumption
variants.description: Your Celestial Revelation sears nearby creatures with searing radiant light.

variants.name: Radiant Soul
variants.description: Your Celestial Revelation gives you spectral wings and a flying speed.

species.name: Aasimar
species.description: Aasimar are souls touched by the power of Mount Celestia, the divine realm of law and good.

species.name: Goliath
species.description: Goliaths are strong and reclusive people who dwell in remote mountain peaks. They are known for their great strength and endurance.

species.name: Goliath
species.description: Goliaths are the distant descendants of giants. They are tough and resilient, with abilities inherited from their giant forebears.

variants.name: Cloud Giant Ancestry
variants.description: Legacy of Cloud Giants.

variants.name: Fire Giant Ancestry
variants.description: Legacy of Fire Giants.

variants.name: Frost Giant Ancestry
variants.description: Legacy of Frost Giants.

variants.name: Hill Giant Ancestry
variants.description: Legacy of Hill Giants.

variants.name: Stone Giant Ancestry
variants.description: Legacy of Stone Giants.

variants.name: Storm Giant Ancestry
variants.description: Legacy of Storm Giants.

species.name: Half-Elf
species.description: Half-elves combine what some say are the best qualities of their elf and human parents: human curiosity, inventiveness, and ambition tempered by the refined senses, love of nature, and artistic tastes of the elves.

variants.name: Aquatic Elf Descent (Swim Speed)
variants.description: Aquatic elf ancestry: instead of Skill Versatility you have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

variants.name: Drow Descent (Drow Magic)
variants.description: Drow ancestry: instead of Skill Versatility you know dancing lights and later cast faerie fire and darkness.

variants.name: Moon or Sun Elf Descent (Cantrip)
variants.description: Moon or sun elf ancestry: instead of Skill Versatility you know one wizard cantrip.

variants.name: Moon or Sun Elf Descent (Weapon Training)
variants.description: Moon or sun elf ancestry: instead of Skill Versatility you gain elf weapon training.

variants.name: Wood Elf Descent (Weapon Training)
variants.description: Wood elf ancestry: instead of Skill Versatility you gain elf weapon training.

variants.name: Wood Elf Descent (Fleet of Foot)
variants.description: Wood elf ancestry: instead of Skill Versatility your walking speed is 35 feet.

variants.name: Wood Elf Descent (Mask of the Wild)
variants.description: Wood elf ancestry: instead of Skill Versatility you can hide when only lightly obscured by natural phenomena.

species.name: Half-Orc
species.description: Half-orcs are the short-tempered and sullen result of human and orc pairings. They are strong and tough, but they are often shunned by both races.

species.name: Firbolg
species.description: Firbolgs are reclusive giant-kin who dwell in remote forests and mountains. They are peaceful and wise, but they can be terrifying when roused to anger.

species.name: Kenku
species.description: Kenku are crow-like humanoids who were transformed by powerful magic. They are cunning and resourceful, but they cannot speak except by mimicking sounds they have heard.

species.name: Tabaxi
species.description: Tabaxi are cat-like humanoids who hail from distant jungles. They are curious, agile, and often follow their whims.

species.name: Triton
species.description: Tritons are fish-like humanoids who dwell in the depths of the ocean. They are guardians of the sea and often serve powerful aquatic beings.

species.name: Bugbear
species.description: Bugbears are hulking, furry goblinoids that tower over their goblin and hobgoblin kin. They are stealthy predators who strike from the shadows.

species.name: Goblin
species.description: Goblins are small, green-skinned creatures that dwell in dark, cramped places. They are cunning and vicious, but they are often cowardly.

species.name: Hobgoblin
species.description: Hobgoblins are large, militaristic goblinoids that organize themselves into legions. They are disciplined warriors who value honor and tradition.

species.name: Kobold
species.description: Kobolds are small, reptilian humanoids that dwell in dark places. They are cowardly and subservient, but they can be surprisingly cunning.

variants.name: Craftiness
variants.description: Gain proficiency in one of Arcana, Investigation, Medicine, Sleight of Hand or Survival.

variants.name: Defiance
variants.description: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the frightened condition on yourself.

variants.name: Draconic Sorcery
variants.description: Learn one cantrip from the sorcerer spell list.

species.name: Yuan-Ti
species.description: Yuan-ti are serpentine humanoids shaped by ancient, dark magic. Those who walk among other peoples pair snake-like features with innate magic and a resistance to poison and spells.

species.name: Fairy
species.description: Fairies are tiny, magical beings from the Feywild. They are playful and mischievous, with a natural affinity for illusion magic.

species.name: Harengon
species.description: Harengons are rabbit-like humanoids who hail from the Feywild. They are quick and lucky, with enhanced senses and agility.

species.name: Loxodon
species.description: Loxodons are elephant-like humanoids known for their wisdom and calm demeanor. They are peaceful and introspective.

species.name: Owlin
species.description: Owlin are owl-like humanoids who can fly silently through the night. They are wise and observant.

species.name: Githyanki
species.description: Githyanki are humanoid warriors from the Astral Plane. They are fierce fighters with psionic abilities.

species.name: Genasi
species.description: Genasi are descended from genies and mortals, and carry the power of an elemental plane in their blood. Air, earth, fire and water genasi each manifest that heritage differently.

variants.name: Air Genasi
variants.description: Descended from djinn: swift (35 ft walking speed), resistant to lightning, and able to hold your breath indefinitely.

variants.name: Earth Genasi
variants.description: Descended from dao or marids of stone: unimpeded by difficult terrain and able to merge into rock.

variants.name: Fire Genasi
variants.description: Descended from efreet: resistant to fire and able to produce flame and burning hands.

variants.name: Water Genasi
variants.description: Descended from marids: resistant to acid, amphibious, and able to shape water.

species.name: Aarakocra
species.description: Aarakocra are bird-folk native to the Elemental Plane of Air. With feathered wings and taloned hands, they are scouts and skirmishers who prize the freedom of the open sky.

species.name: Centaur
species.description: Centaurs have the upper body of a humanoid and the lower body of a horse. Swift and powerful, they are creatures of the wilds who charge into battle and run the plains.

species.name: Changeling
species.description: Changelings are fey shapeshifters who can alter their faces and voices at will. They blend into any society, and many guard their true selves closely.

species.name: Deep Gnome
species.description: Deep gnomes, or svirfneblin, live in the Underdark. They are small, stone-gray and wary, with a talent for hiding among rock and for resisting magic.

species.name: Duergar
species.description: Duergar, or gray dwarves, are dwarves of the Underdark whose spirit was bent by mind flayer psionics. They are grim, resilient and gifted with innate magic.

species.name: Eladrin
species.description: Eladrin are elves of the Feywild whose moods shift with the seasons. They can step through space in a flash of fey magic.

species.name: Githzerai
species.description: Githzerai are disciplined ascetics from the chaos of Limbo. They hone their minds to shield themselves from psychic harm and shape their surroundings by will.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.description: Lizardfolk are reptilian survivors of swamps and rivers. Practical and unsentimental, they hunt with tooth and claw and read the wild with a keen instinct.

species.name: Minotaur
species.description: Minotaurs are bull-headed warriors of great strength. They charge into foes with their horns and rarely lose their way, however twisting the path.

species.name: Satyr
species.description: Satyrs are fey revelers with goat legs and horns. They love music, wine and good company, and are hard for magic to bend.

species.name: Sea Elf
species.description: Sea elves are elves of the ocean depths. They breathe the sea's secrets, swim with ease and can speak with creatures that live below the waves.

species.name: Shadar-Kai
species.description: Shadar-kai are elves of the Shadowfell, touched by the Raven Queen. They are austere and pale, and they can slip briefly through the shadows.

species.name: Shifter
species.description: Shifters carry lycanthropic ancestry that lets them assume a more bestial form for a short time. Each shifter's instincts favor a particular beast-like gift.

variants.name: Beasthide
variants.description: Tough and resilient: you gain extra temporary hit points and +1 AC while shifted.

variants.name: Longtooth
variants.description: Fierce and aggressive: you gain a fanged bite attack while shifted.

variants.name: Swiftstride
variants.description: Graceful and quick: you gain extra speed and can move without provoking while shifted.

variants.name: Wildhunt
variants.description: Sharp-eyed and attuned: you gain advantage on Wisdom checks and saves while shifted.

species.name: Tortle
species.description: Tortles are turtle-like wanderers with a protective shell. They carry their home on their backs and travel in search of new places to understand.

species.name: Astral Elf
species.description: Astral elves are elves of Wildspace and the Astral Sea, shaped by starlight. They step between places in a flash and draw on the shared memory of the Astral Plane.

species.name: Autognome
species.description: Autognomes are mechanical gnomes with free will, built by the rock gnomes and others who chose to let their creations decide their own purpose.

species.name: Giff
species.description: Giff are hippo-headed soldiers of impressive size who love firearms, order and a good campaign. They channel a spark of divine power through their weapons.

species.name: Hadozee
species.description: Hadozee are simian adventurers who adapt well to the hazards of Wildspace. Gliding membranes and agile feet make them natural sailors and climbers.

species.name: Plasmoid
species.description: Plasmoids are amoeba-like people who can reshape their bodies at will, squeezing through narrow gaps and shrugging off acid and poison.

species.name: Thri-kreen
species.description: Thri-kreen are telepathic, insectile hunters with four arms and a chameleon carapace. They do not sleep and speak mind to mind.

species.name: Leonin
species.description: Leonin are proud, lion-like people of Theros who live in prides. They are fierce hunters with claws and a roar that can frighten their foes.

species.name: Simic Hybrid
species.description: Simic hybrids are humans, elves and vedalken whom the Simic Combine has altered with animal traits. Each hybrid chooses enhancements such as gills or climbing limbs.

species.name: Vedalken
species.description: Vedalken are tall, blue-skinned and fiercely rational. They pursue perfection with dispassionate precision and can breathe underwater for a time.

species.name: Dhampir
species.description: Dhampirs are people who carry a vampire's curse. They climb like spiders, see in the dark and feed on the life of those they bite.

species.name: Hexblood
species.description: Hexbloods are people touched by a hag's magic, often through a bargain or a curse. They can cast hexes and see through an eerie token.

species.name: Reborn
species.description: The reborn are people who have escaped death, returned with glimpses of past lives and a resilience that death itself could not break.

species.name: Verdan
species.description: Verdan are goblins transformed by the magic of That-Which-Endures. They grow from Small to Medium over time and speak mind to mind.

species.name: Kalashtar
species.description: Kalashtar are humans bonded to spirits from the plane of dreams, who have fled the nightmare tyrants of Dal Quor. They link minds with ease and carry a spirit's quiet discipline.

species.name: Warforged
species.description: Warforged are living constructs built for the Last War. They do not tire or sleep as others do, and they weave armor into their own bodies.

species.name: Custom Lineage
species.description: A custom lineage is a way to build the origin you imagine: you gain a +2 to one ability, a feat, and either darkvision or a skill proficiency.

variants.name: Darkvision
variants.description: Your variable trait is darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

variants.name: Skill Proficiency
variants.description: Your variable trait is proficiency in one skill of your choice.

species.name: Dragonborn (Chromatic)
species.description: Chromatic dragonborn descend from evil dragons of acid, lightning, poison, fire or cold. Their breath is a 30-foot line, and at 5th level they can ward themselves against their element.

species.name: Dragonborn (Gem)
species.description: Gem dragonborn descend from dragons of psionic crystal and carry that mind-power with them. They can send telepathic messages and, at 5th level, sprout spectral wings.

species.name: Dragonborn (Metallic)
species.description: Metallic dragonborn descend from good dragons of brass, bronze, copper, gold or silver. At 5th level they gain a second breath weapon that incapacitates or repels foes.

species.name: Dwarf (Mark of Warding)
species.description: Dragonmarked dwarves of House Kundarak bear the Mark of Warding, a gift for locks, wards and protective magic.

species.name: Elf (Mark of Shadow)
species.description: Elves of House Phiarlan or Thuranni with the Mark of Shadow are performers and spies who can bend darkness and illusion.

species.name: Gnome (Mark of Scribing)
species.description: Gnomes of House Sivis bear the Mark of Scribing, which makes them natural messengers, notaries and translators.

species.name: Halfling (Mark of Healing)
species.description: Halflings of House Jorasco with the Mark of Healing are the healers of Khorvaire, mending wounds with innate magic.

species.name: Halfling (Mark of Hospitality)
species.description: Halflings of House Ghallanda bear the Mark of Hospitality, a gift for welcome, comfort and a good meal.

species.name: Human (Mark of Handling)
species.description: Humans of House Vadalis with the Mark of Handling have a bond with beasts and a talent for training them.

species.name: Human (Mark of Making)
species.description: Humans of House Cannith bear the Mark of Making, which lets them craft and mend with magical ease.

species.name: Human (Mark of Passage)
species.description: Humans of House Orien with the Mark of Passage are tireless couriers who move faster than others and step through space.

species.name: Human (Mark of Sentinel)
species.description: Humans of House Deneith bearing the Mark of Sentinel are bodyguards who can take a blow meant for an ally.

species.name: Human (Mark of Finding)
species.description: Humans of House Tharashk with the Mark of Finding are hunters and trackers who can locate nearly anything.

species.name: Half-Elf (Mark of Detection)
species.description: Half-elves of House Medani with the Mark of Detection are investigators who sense magic, poison and hidden things.

species.name: Half-Elf (Mark of Storm)
species.description: Half-elves of House Lyrandar bear the Mark of Storm, with command of wind, weather and a resistance to lightning.

species.name: Half-Orc (Mark of Finding)
species.description: Half-orcs of the Shadow Marches with the Mark of Finding are hunters and trackers who can locate nearly anything.

species.name: Elf (Pallid)
species.description: Pallid elves are pale, moon-touched elves of Xhorhas, shaped by a blessing of the Moon Weaver.

species.name: Halfling (Ghostwise)
species.description: Ghostwise halflings are reclusive, forest-dwelling halflings who speak with their minds.

species.name: Halfling (Lotusden)
species.description: Lotusden halflings live in the Lotusden forest of Wildemount and have a quiet magic of the wood.

species.name: Dragonborn (Draconblood)
species.description: Draconblood dragonborn are diplomats and scholars, born to the shared bloodlines of the Dragon Empire.

species.name: Dragonborn (Ravenite)
species.description: Ravenite dragonborn are fierce warriors who take vengeance on anyone who wounds them.

species.name: Changeling
species.description: Changelings are shape-shifting fey descendants who can reshape their face, voice and build at will.

species.name: Kalashtar
species.description: Kalashtar are people bonded to spirits from the plane of dreams, linked mind to mind and shielded from psychic harm.

species.name: Khoravar
species.description: Khoravar are the children of elves and humans in Eberron: versatile, fey-touched and at home in two worlds.

species.name: Shifter
species.description: Shifters carry the blood of lycanthropes and can take on a more bestial form for a short time.

species.name: Warforged
species.description: Warforged are living constructs built for war. They do not sleep or tire as others do and weave armor into their own bodies.

species.name: Dhampir
species.description: Dhampirs carry the curse of vampire blood: quick, keen-eyed and able to drain life with a bite.

species.name: Hexblood
species.description: Hexbloods are touched by a hag's magic, bearing an eerie token that lets them speak and see across distance.

species.name: Lupin
species.description: Lupins carry the blood of werewolves: sharp senses, slashing claws and a chilling howl.

species.name: Reborn
species.description: The reborn have died and returned, resisting death's touch and remembering glimpses of a past life.

species.name: Boggart
species.description: Boggarts are goblin-like natives of Lorwyn who love mischief, novelty and odd alchemy.

species.name: Faerie
species.description: Faeries are tiny winged tricksters of Lorwyn and Shadowmoor, with innate nature magic.

species.name: Flamekin
species.description: Flamekin are genasi-like people of Lorwyn marked by fire: expressive, resistant to flame and gifted at conjuring it.

species.name: Kithkin
species.description: Kithkin are halfling-like folk of Lorwyn, close-knit, lucky and skilled at crafting.

species.name: Lorwyn Changeling
species.description: Lorwyn changelings take any guise: harbingers of good luck who can reshape into a humanoid or a four-legged beast.

species.name: Rimekin
species.description: Rimekin are genasi-like people of Lorwyn shaped by ice and cold fire, who shrug off the cold.

species.name: Bullywug
species.description: Frogfolk of the swamps. They breathe water as easily as air and leap farther than their stride suggests.

species.name: Gnoll
species.description: Hyena-folk with a powerful bite. Dropping a foe lets them surge forward and bite again.

species.name: Grimlock
species.description: Eyeless hunters of the Underdark. They sense prey by sound and smell and blend into stone.

species.name: Kuo-Toa
species.description: Fishlike people of the Underdark. They sense creatures others cannot see and slip free of a grapple.

species.name: Merfolk
species.description: People of the sea. They are slow on land, swift in the water, and able to breathe air.

species.name: Skeleton
species.description: An animated skeleton: brittle, tireless, and immune to poison. It cannot speak, but it understands the languages of its former life.

species.name: Troglodyte
species.description: A cave-dweller with a thick hide and a stench that sickens anything standing close.

species.name: Zombie
species.description: A walking corpse that sometimes refuses to fall, and that shrugs off poison.
